about: The speakable AI disclosure the runtime's RD1 first-breath fallback says when her first sentence does not already say she is an AI. agent.opening.disclosureClause is GUIDANCE for the brief compiler (e.g. 'that you are its AI assistant, mentioned in passing') and is never spoken. One fixed line per language, built from the brand's spoken name; a language with no checked line uses the fallback. Both doors read this file: product/voice/vpvoice/safety.py disclosure_line() and product/tests/safety-disclosure.test.ts. Every line must pass lexicon.ai_affirm in rules.json (tested on both sides).
